note: The Patriots play the Lions in Munich and the Celtics host the Mavericks, both today.

front.title: Tesla opens Cybercab pre-orders 'for personal use,' with geo restrictions and a $299 monthly fee
front.tldr: Tesla has opened pre-orders for personal Cybercab ownership, limited to certain areas and requiring a $299 monthly software fee. Even Elon Musk said the fee was too high.

front.title: Here's a HomeView feature that should come to every Apple device
front.tldr: Apple's new HomeView smart display has an ambient dark mode that softens its screen in low light. 9to5Mac argues the feature should spread to every Apple device.

front.title: Our writers on Antonelli's title success and what it means
front.tldr: After Kimi Antonelli was crowned the 2026 Formula 1 drivers' champion, Formula1.com's writers gave their take on what his title win means for the sport.

stories.title: Jensen Huang's departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
stories.tldr: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups while Jensen Huang ran the company. Founders and investors now expect smaller cheques and lower valuations without him.

stories.title: datasette-llm 0.1a11
stories.tldr: Simon Willison released version 0.1a11 of datasette-llm, the plugin that lets other Datasette plugins configure which language models they use.

stories.title: datasette-vega 0.7
stories.tldr: Simon Willison shipped version 0.7 of datasette-vega, Datasette's longest-untouched plugin for Vega-Lite charts: its last release was back in July 2018.

stories.title: This Sony patent would add a credit card reader to your PlayStation controller
stories.tldr: Sony has filed a patent for a PlayStation controller with a built-in credit card reader, aimed at easing purchases as the platform moves toward digital-only consoles.

stories.title: HomeView review: a late arrival with promise, but still showing some seams
stories.tldr: Jason Snell says HomeView's hardware is solid and coherent and the screen a pleasure to use, but the software feels like an amalgam of other Apple products.

stories.title: Indie App Spotlight: 'Milton' lets you turn your old iPad into a home dashboard
stories.tldr: 9to5Mac's weekly Indie App Spotlight picks Milton, an app that turns an old iPad into a home dashboard.

stories.title: Apple @ Work: the spiritual successor to the Xserve is here, thanks to Apple silicon and MLX
stories.tldr: 9to5Mac argues Apple silicon and the MLX framework now do the job the discontinued Xserve once did, without Apple needing to ship its own LLM.

stories.title: 'Fatherland' Wins Top Camerimage Prize as 'Wild Horse Nine' Nabs Audience Award
stories.tldr: 'Fatherland' won the top prize at the Camerimage film festival, which honours cinematography, with 'Wild Horse Nine' taking the audience award.

stories.title: Box Office: Johnny Depp's 'Ebenezer' Leads With $6.7 Million on Opening Day
stories.tldr: 'Ebenezer,' Johnny Depp's take on Scrooge, led Friday's box office with $6.7 million on opening day, ahead of 'How to Rob a Bank' at $2.2 million.

stories.title: Danny Boyle Talks 'Ink', The Common Architecture Of His Movies And More '28 Years Later' As He Receives The Deadline Legend Award
stories.tldr: Accepting Deadline's Legend Award, Danny Boyle reflected on the common threads running through films from Shallow Grave and Trainspotting to Ink.

stories.title: 'Fatherland,' 'La Bola Negra,' 'Fjord' Lead European Film Award Nominations
stories.tldr: Sandra Hüller picked up a dual best actress nomination at the European Film Awards, alongside Renate Reinsve, Sebastian Stan, Penélope Cruz, Javier Bardem and Andrew Scott.

stories.title: Celtics get good injury news ahead of game against Mavericks
stories.tldr: The Celtics have a clean injury report, with Paul George and the rest of the roster available for Sunday night's home game against the Mavericks.

stories.title: The NBA is all about fit. Paul George and the Celtics fit together perfectly.
stories.tldr: CelticsBlog argues Paul George's game suits Boston's system well, pushing back on narratives about him formed before he joined the Celtics.

stories.title: Mike Vrabel, Patriots embracing Munich ahead of international matchup vs. Lions
stories.tldr: The Patriots play their first ever game in Munich on Sunday. Mike Vrabel marked the trip on Saturday night by tapping a keg of German beer for himself.

stories.title: A.J. Brown is questionable for the Patriots' game against the Lions in Germany
stories.tldr: A.J. Brown (ankle and knee) and Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) are listed as questionable for the Patriots' Sunday game against the Lions in Munich.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli meets Italian president Sergio Mattarella
stories.tldr: New Formula 1 champion Kimi Antonelli met Italian president Sergio Mattarella, part of a run of meetings and celebrations for his title win.

stories.title: Toto Wolff's journey from Williams to nine F1 titles
stories.tldr: A profile of Toto Wolff's path from racing driver to Mercedes team boss, where he has now matched Sir Frank Williams's record of nine constructors' championships.

stories.title: Antonelli names his biggest threat for 2027 title defence
stories.tldr: Reigning champion Kimi Antonelli has given his view on which driver poses the biggest threat to his title in 2027, his first season defending it.

stories.title: What experts are saying about Red Sox reportedly signing 2026 NLCS MVP Jake Bauers
stories.tldr: Pundits reportedly think Boston got a bargain in signing Jake Bauers, the 2026 NLCS MVP, who fills a need in the Red Sox lineup.

finally.title: This week Sony revived its classic Walkman headphones
finally.tldr: Sony has relaunched its original Walkman headphones with colourful foam pads, leaning into 1980s nostalgia.
